lost_ack_recovery_protocol.step_1_submit: Execute POST /api/mobile/v2/companies/{companyId}/sales/online-cash with target client_event_id. Server executes transaction, commits to MariaDB (receipt status=completed with invoice and payment IDs). In test harness, transport boundary intercepts wire response after commit.
lost_ack_recovery_protocol.step_2_transport_witness: Harness creates atomic 0600 witness and terminates HTTP request without wire response. In accordance with Root review, this network socket drop is declared UNRUN until verified with live network witness.
lost_ack_recovery_protocol.step_3_recovery: Client observes socket drop/timeout. Client MUST NOT resubmit a fresh POST. Client executes GET /api/mobile/v2/companies/{companyId}/offline-events/{clientEventId}/status.
lost_ack_recovery_protocol.step_4_assert: Client asserts HTTP 200, status='posted', non-null matching invoice_id, payment_id, and identical server_canonical_digest matching original intent.

verification_rules.metric_delta: Assert all 9 accounting row counts have strictly zero net delta (pre-probe == post-probe)
verification_rules.sequence_delta: Assert full document_sequences map (document_type, year, next_number) is identical with zero gaps
verification_rules.stock_quantity: Assert stock_movements_qty_delta_base and lot_allocations_qty_allocated_base exact decimal strings are unchanged
verification_rules.fingerprint_delta: Assert row_fingerprint_sha256 is strictly identical between pre-probe and post-probe snapshots
verification_rules.reconciliations: Assert all 6 reconciliation services (accounting, inventory, sales, payables, money, phase7) pass with 0 issues
